messages:
Lena: dropped a compact mock for the vectors preview toolbar. main concern: Export is stealing attention from Preview. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-preview :eyes:
Omar: agree. users hitting Export by accident causes huge jobs. Suggest making Preview the primary CTA and moving Export into the overflow menu
Priyanka: accessibility: keyboard order currently lands on Export first. That needs to follow visual priority. Also the small blue Export button fails contrast at 12px
Diego: backend note: exports create a heavy worker job. If accidental, they queue long-running tasks. We should show estimated size ahead of queuing and mark exports low priority by default
Ruth (PM): timeline: can we do the toolbar swap for tomorrow's staging build? confirm modal can be follow-up
Lena: proposed changes: 1) Primary: Preview (solid), 2) Secondary: Save selection (outline), 3) Overflow: Export selected / Export all / CSV options. 4) Show sample CSV header and approximate size in modal
a11y-bot: suggestion: add aria-live announcement when export modal opens and use aria-describedby for the size + header. Ensure modal focus moves to first control and returns to toolbar on close
Priyanka: copy tweak: use 'Export selected vectors (.csv)' and have CTA read 'Export (~1.8 MB)'. Also add non-color relevance indicators on rows (e.g., icon + text)
Omar: small UX: when a large selection happens (>1k rows) show a non-dismissable warning toast: "You selected 1,200 rows 14 exporting may take several minutes" with Cancel link
Diego: will implement progress events and a download link email/notification. Also ensure exports are rate-limited per-tenant so interactive preview traffic isn't impacted
Ruth (PM): ok stack: Preview primary, Export in overflow, filesize + sample header, keyboard/focus fixes, SR announcements. Landing tonight if all agree
Lena: I'll update Figma and include keyboard-only flows + screencast. tagging the group once done
Priyanka: add NVDA/VoiceOver test cases for modal readout and header announcement
Omar: thanks, all. small follow-up: consider moving export confirmation into an inline panel for power users in a later iteration
Lena: noted. closing thread for now
